title: CONNECT-IP URI Template Expansion Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP URI Template variable, expansion, validation, abort, and default-template policy.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpUriTemplate` accepts optional `target`, `ipproto`, and other variables, expands simple path and query variables, rejects empty `target` or `ipproto` values when present, enforces printable ASCII and forbidden operator policy, exposes validation and invalid-template abort decisions, and constructs the default CONNECT-IP template.
data_and_state_considerations: Expansion returns request target components and does not validate target/ipproto grammar beyond non-empty variable values in this slice.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Unresolved variables are rejected at expansion time.
The default template is available without preventing custom templates.
Forbidden operator checks remain conservative and shared with validation.
risks: Full target and ipproto grammar validation is intentionally deferred to the Section 4.6 slice.
